description: Quotation with author and source: a passage in the text or a testimonial in the spotlight.

howToUse: Pass the quoted text without quotation marks; the component draws the mark in the testimonial variant.
`variant="block"` sits inside an article with the line on the left; `variant="pull"` is a testimonial with photo or initials.
Put the role, company or origin in `source`, so the quote can be checked.
alternatives: A tip or warning that is not someone's words: Callout.
A chat message: Message or Bubble.

keyboard.action: The quote does not receive focus. Screen readers read it as a block quotation with its author.

props.name: cite
props.description: URL the quotation comes from (the `cite` attribute).

props.name: children
props.description: The quoted text, without quotation marks: the component draws the mark.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback called when the value changes.
